vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are linked as pairs. The Brown and Green ones are linked together, and the Red and Purple are linked together. On each round, select the same pair each time until the amount of mushrooms drops to around 3 or below. When the amount is low (around 3 or below), switch to the other pair. Occasionally there will be periods when both pairs of gnomes return low numbers (3 or below), and switching pairs makes no difference. This is temporary. When this happens keep following the rule, switching between the pairs until the amount of mushrooms dropped rises to 4 or above.The maximum amount of mushrooms per round is 9.
